name: Essential Trust Badges
summary: Shopify app (by Essential Apps) that adds payment icons, feature icons, guarantee badges and promo banners to product pages, the cart or any theme position, with your own icons, country targeting and translations; plans are metered on widget views.
best_for: Shopify merchants who want payment icons, feature icons and guarantee or shipping badges under the add-to-cart button without code, starting free, and who will pay $9.99 once they need badges in the cart, per-country badges or translations
skip_if: your cart drawer comes from a third-party app, because the help centre says only theme cart drawers are supported; or you want several distinct badge blocks per product page and refuse to pay, because the free plan allows one banner or one three-icon block
honest_knock:
The free plan is generous on views and tight on badges. It allows 5,000 views a month, more than the vendor's countdown and announcement-bar apps give away, but only one product-page banner or one block of three icons, plus payment icons. A store that wants a shipping promise under the add-to-cart button and a separate guarantee block further down is already on Starter, and uploading your own icon instead of choosing from the library also starts there.

The badge people most often want, the one next to the checkout button, is on the $9.99 Essential plan. The help centre says cart-page and cart-drawer badges are not available on Free or Starter, and adds two limits that are easy to miss: the app supports your theme's own cart drawer only, not third-party cart-drawer apps, and a badge placed with the custom-position method appears on the cart page but no longer inside the drawer. If your store uses a slide-cart app, check this before you pay for the plan that includes it.

Views are counted per widget load, so every badge on a page adds a view each time the page opens, including your own visits; preview mode and the theme customiser are not counted. Past the limit nothing is charged, but three days after the warning email the badges are unpublished until the 1st of the month. The critical reviews are few, three one-star and two three-star out of 1,163, and they are about setup rather than billing: one store gave up after a week trying to show two product-page banners, which the vendor replied needed two product-page badges rather than one product and one cart badge, and one wanted more design options without writing CSS. A badge is also a claim: show only guarantees, returns and security marks you actually offer.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Starter · per month for up to 20,000 widget views, or $67.08 a year
pricing.notes: (re-read 2026-11-26 on apps.shopify.com/essential-icon-badge-banners: every plan name and amount unchanged; first read 2026-09-30 on apps.shopify.com/essential-icon-badge-banners, on essential-apps.com/trust-badges and in the vendor's help articles on views, cart placement and badges not showing) Four plans priced on monthly widget views. Free covers up to 5,000 views a month, the full icon library, unlimited payment icons on product pages and one product-page banner or one block of three icons. Starter is $6.99 a month, or $67.08 a year at a stated 20% saving, for up to 20,000 views, and adds unlimited product-page blocks, unlimited icons per block and uploading your own icons. Essential is $9.99 a month or $95.88 a year for up to 50,000 views, and adds cart-page and cart-drawer badges, placing badges by product tag, geolocation targeting and translations. Professional is $29.99 a month or $287.88 a year for unlimited views and every premium feature. Paid plans carry a 7-day free trial. A view is counted every time a badge widget loads, not once per visitor, and your own browsing counts too. There is no overage charge: past the limit you get an email, and if you do not upgrade within 3 days the badges are unpublished until views reset on the 1st of the month. All charges are in USD, billed through Shopify every 30 days. Developer Essential Apps, with an address in Vilnius, Lithuania; the listing gives a launch date of 2 June 2023 and shows 1,163 reviews.

free_plan_evidence: Free covers up to 5,000 views a month, the full icon library, unlimited payment icons on product pages and one product-page banner or one block of three icons.

compare_with.name: Essential Announcement Bar
compare_with.why: Essential Announcement Bar is the vendor's sister app and the closest comparison in our own dossiers, because both put store promises in front of shoppers and both are priced on views with the same $6.99, $9.99 and $29.99 ladder. They sit in different places. The announcement bar runs across the top of every page for shipping terms, offers and notices, and on our reading of 29 September 2026 its free plan covered 2,000 views with the scrolling bar starting on Starter. Trust Badges sits on the product page and, from Essential, in the cart, next to the decision to buy, with a free plan of 5,000 views but only one badge block. A store that wants one site-wide message fits the bar; a store that wants reassurance next to the buy button fits the badges, and many stores run both, which means two view counters to watch.

exit_test.what: We created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session tested Essential Trust Badges on a Shopify development store: the install through the install form, the free plan without a card or plan screen, one icon block with three badges (Free Shipping, Easy Returns, Secure Checkout) published in the app in 6 steps, then the block below Add to cart and Buy it now in an unsaved theme preview of The Complete Snowboard after the app embed was switched on by hand (about 2 minutes from the install; the embed was switched off again), the Pricing plans page with the free plan and three paid plans, and the Shopify approval screen for Starter (a 7-day trial; it asked for a payment method and had no test charge sentence; nothing approved), after which the app was uninstalled. The cart page badges, geolocation, translations and the paid plans were not tested. Nothing was paid. Install: the app was installed from its App Store listing through the install form with the target set to the same tab, in our own tab, at about 21:32 to 21:33. In the Shopify admin the app is called Essential Trust Badges (by Essential Apps). The screen Install app said that the app needs access to View staff and contributor data (Store owner) and View and edit store data (Products, Online Store); Install was clicked. There was no terms tick box, no separate account on the vendor site and no link with an outside account: the app opened at once on the plan Free, with the line You're currently on Free (0 / 5000 monthly views), a setup guide Activate app embed in Shopify, a partner banner Let's share the revenue (a 30% commission programme for the person who installs, not used and not relevant for a shop owner) and a banner Q4 offer: 5 apps for $99/mo. Core action, one set of trust badges: it took about 2 minutes and 6 steps from the install (about 21:33) to the badges in the preview (about 21:35): Create new badge, Product page, Icon block, Placement All products, Publish, and the app embed switched on in the theme editor. The badge type chooser offered Product page (Block in product page below add to cart button), Cart page (Available with Essential plan. Upgrade now.) and Checkout trust (View app, which leads to another app). The Icon block gave three badges by default: Free Shipping / No Extra Costs, Easy Returns / Return with Ease and Secure Checkout / Secure Payment. For the placement All products was available, and All products with specific tags, Customers with specific tags and Geolocation targeting were greyed out with Available with Essential plan. Publish gave the toast Badge published, followed by a banner Essential Trust Badges app is not activated yet. In the theme editor (App embeds, product The Complete Snowboard) the embed Icon & Badge Banners was switched on and NOT saved. The preview showed the block with the three badges below Add to cart and Buy it now. The embed was switched off again and the editor was left with Leave page, so nothing was saved. Only the preview for one product was looked at; mobile, the cart and other themes were not. Plans in the app (Pricing plans, Billed Monthly): Free: Up to 5.000 monthly views, One product page banner or icon block with 3 icons, Unlimited product page payment icons. Starter $6.99 a month: Up to 20.000 monthly views, Unlimited Product page blocks, Unlimited icons in a block, Upload your own icons. Essential (Popular) $9.99 a month: Up to 50.000 monthly views, Unlimited cart page blocks, Adding block using product tags, Geolocation targeting, Translations. Professional $29.99 a month: Unlimited views and all premium features. Each paid plan has a button Start FREE 7-day trial. A switch Billed Yearly - Save 20% was shown; the yearly prices were not opened. According to our notes this matches the listing and the review. Checkout: Start FREE 7-day trial on Starter opened the Shopify screen Approve subscription with the plan starter, $6,99 USD every 30 days, You have a 7-day free trial ending on 24 Nov., Subtotal $6,99 plus any applicable taxes, Total Due 24 Nov $6,99, a row Add payment method and the line By proceeding, you are agreeing to the Terms of Service. The Approve button was greyed out. The screen did NOT say that a test charge would not be billed, and a payment method was needed, so the test charge was not allowed. No card was entered and nothing was approved; Cancel was clicked. Cancelling: no paid plan was started, so there was nothing to cancel in the app. According to the listing the way back is Free on the Pricing plans page or removing the app; the menu with Uninstall (Open app, View details, Uninstall) was seen in Settings, Apps, and the app was uninstalled after the test. Differences from the review: the prices and the limits match (Free 5.000 views, Starter $6.99 for 20.000, Essential $9.99 for 50.000, Professional $29.99 unlimited). The price fields are not changed here. Not tested: the cart page and cart drawer badges (Essential plan), geolocation, translations, uploading your own icons, placement by tags, the paid plans and the payment, the view limit and unpublishing, the mobile view, the live store and the combination with other apps. Clean up: the embed was switched off and the theme was not saved. The badge Your badge (published) stayed in the app until the uninstall. The app was uninstalled in Settings, Apps. No card was entered and nothing was approved. Our own tab was closed. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The published badge did not show on the store until the app embed was switched on by hand in the theme editor; the app says so in a banner after publishing. The start screen also showed a partner banner (Let's share the revenue, a 30% commission programme) and a Q4 offer for five apps, which a shop owner does not need. The Starter approval screen needed a payment method, so a test charge could not be approved.
